title: REPORT on combating VAT fraud – the effectiveness of cross-border cooperation when it comes to VAT fraud and its impact on the EU budget
part_text: Stresses that the AFA revision should suggest measures to prevent a lack of judicial independence, ineffective prosecution services and insufficient anti-corruption safeguards, in such a way to prevent, detect and recover VAT fraud; points out that where structural vulnerabilities create heightened risk for VAT fraud losses, targeted recommendations are required and recalls that the Conditionality Regulation[[12]](#footnote-13)12 allows measures to be taken where deficiencies in tackling tax fraud, tax evasion, corruption and other breaches affect the collection of EU revenues;
